title: After the TTL the answer is gone
goal: For {{castBrand}}, {{castApp}} reuses answers for {{castTask}}, but an answer must not live for ever.
obstacle: A cached answer that never expires could go stale.
control: The key's TTL is counted on the lab clock: an answer is live from the moment it is stored until the TTL passes, and at exactly that time it is gone, so the next ask goes to the model again.
